tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt: per-file triage table classified every file migrate-as-is / migrate-with-adaptation and rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml; build produced only nullable warnings, no errors.

tool_limitations.limitation: Background-task detection matches only '\bIBackgroundTask\b|BackgroundTaskBuilder'. The in-process background model this sample uses touches BackgroundExecutionManager, BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup, SystemTrigger/TimeTrigger/ApplicationTrigger and Application.OnBackgroundActivated WITHOUT necessarily naming IBackgroundTask/BackgroundTaskBuilder, so files can dodge the background-tasks TODO routing.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Broaden the adaptable pattern to the whole in-process background family so any such file is routed to the background-tasks anchor.

failed_apis.why_tried: Migrated 1:1 from the UWP sample's RegisterBackgroundTask helper.
failed_apis.root_cause: The legacy in-process background model compiles under WinAppSDK but is not wired to run in a packaged desktop app: no windows.backgroundTasks <Extensions> declaration in Package.appxmanifest (copied migrate-as-is with none) and the single-process activation entry differs. Register() therefore produces no visible Status change.
failed_apis.fix: Declare the windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension (task types systemEvent/timer/general, in-process => no EntryPoint) and keep the in-process BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup.BackgroundActivated wiring; or migrate to the WinAppSDK BackgroundTaskBuilder.

special_apis.special_handling: UWP override has NO equivalent on Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application. Dev-agent correctly dropped the override and wired group.BackgroundActivated += BackgroundActivity.Start in the App constructor for the grouped task. Ungrouped in-process tasks that relied on OnBackgroundActivated need the AppInstance/ExtendedActivationKind model instead.
TimeTrigger/ApplicationTrigger tasks call it; it requires an interactive foreground grant and is environment-gated headlessly.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold enables <Nullable>enable</Nullable> but UWP source assigns null literals / leaves auto-properties (Scenario.Title/ClassType, Grouped 'group' field, MainPage.Current) uninitialized.
errors_encountered.fix: Warnings only, non-blocking; nullable-annotate or use 'required'/'= null!' as the skill already documents.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: UWP App overrode OnBackgroundActivated and used partial void Construct(); WinUI 3 Application exposes neither.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No WinUI 3 equivalent for Application.OnBackgroundActivated; partial Construct() is a UWP codegen hook.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Dropped the override; moved group.BackgroundActivated wiring into the App constructor.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A background-tasks section that explicitly names the OnBackgroundActivated -> BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup.BackgroundActivated transform.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Register click produced no Status change in the migrated app; capped every scenario at partial.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a (not observed at build time; surfaced only at score time)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: In-process background registration not wired for a packaged WinUI 3 app (no windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension); compiles but is behaviourally dead.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill warning that legacy background APIs compile-but-die without the manifest extension + a checklist to add it (or switch to WinAppSDK BackgroundTaskBuilder).

env_issues.issue: UWP golden un-capturable (splash only) and background registration is environment-gated (needs interactive foreground grant); behaviour could not be verified either side.
env_issues.workaround: Baseline fell back to source-derived checklist + .xaml reading; behaviour flagged for manual review.
